name: Believing In Christ
overview: The Scriptures clearly teach that believing in Christ is the essential pathway to eternal life and freedom from condemnation. Jesus Himself affirms that all things are possible to those who believe (Mark 9:23) and emphasizes that belief in Him grants everlasting life (John 3:16; John 6:47). Conversely, rejecting belief in Christ results in remaining under God's wrath and dying in sin (John 3:36; John 8:24). Faith in the Son is not merely intellectual assent but a transformative trust that moves a person from death to life (John 5:24).
